117.long_description: Arcooda's Pinball Arcade Generic Software provides a package with 76 past pinball titles, playable on virtually any cabinet, that way you can build your own and just install the Arcooda software. This standalone software package includes 76 pinball titles and does not require you to keep your cabinet connected to the internet. Whilst titles from Williams/Bally are in limited stock due to expiration of licence on Arcooda Pinball Arcade, they continue to be available until stock has sold out. Installation takes less than 10 minutes through a quick and easy process so you can jump straight into your ideal pinball environment. With customised video and enhanced graphics, Arcooda's Pinball Arcade provides easy access to some of the world's most popular pinball titles, ranging from The Addams Family to Doctor Who: Master of Time. To install software, purchase and download the software onto a USB dongle, or purchase it with an Arcooda dongle to have shipped, insert the dongle into your computer/cabinet, allocate your screen sizes and locations in your setup and you're good to go! Generic Cabinet software supports both 2 and 3 monitor screen cabinet versions, as well as being designed for Xbox controller key mapping and 3D Kinect gameplay support to all 76 games for Windows 10 users. More information can be found here Installation video tutorial here
